summary: First-principles design review, iteration 12 (full record in review_loop/scrutiny_12.md). The headline claim, confirmatory family, matching design, and SS0.1 framing were re-examined and stand. This pass executed iteration 11's named worklist — the remaining unaudited third-party seams plus the harness marker constants and the doc chain — and found the last seam dirty: the SDLG arm's generator-side plumbing and failure semantics. (T1, major, fixed) The SDLG importance term I_ij was DEAD in the live configuration: _get_importance_scores derived the vLLM server root with api_base.rstrip('/v1'), which strips a character SET, not a suffix — 'http://localhost:8001/v1' became 'http://localhost:800' (the checked-in config pins port 8001 because host port 8000 is owned by the PDF-reader relay). Every importance query (top-k logprobs AND echo fallback) would have hit a dead port with exceptions swallowed at debug level, zeroing all I_ij — so the documented SS2.4 text-level vocabulary bridge would silently not have executed and SDLG ranking degraded from (A+S+I)/3 to (A+S)/3 with no trace in any artifact. Port 8000 worked by luck ('0' not in the strip set), which is how it survived development; the mocked tests never observed the URL. Fixed with suffix-safe derivation + a regression test pinning the live-config URL. (T2, major, fixed) The SDLG arm silently switched diversity mechanisms on failure: generate() fell back to TemperatureSampler(temperature=0.7) when SDLG produced no alternatives, and the orchestrator records every fork as 'sdlg_fork' — so temperature-sampled branches would be attributed to gradient-guided substitution in the R3.1 generator ablation and the R5.4 confidence-independent-mechanism analysis (the only trace was a stderr warning), and the hardcoded 0.7 broke the R2.4 temperature match in the T=0.2/1.0 sweep cells. Fixed by removing the fallback: no alternatives -> no fork (the instance stays a single greedy trajectory, flagged by realized-N reporting; conservative for the treatment at matched k*), unifying failure semantics with the strategy arm's collapse-to-dominant-representative. R3.1 amended with a fallback-layer attributability clause (applied_12_arm_purity_no_silent_fallback.md; tripwire-checked: adds an obligation discharged same-iteration, flips nothing). Seams audited CLEAN: harness markers verified against installed swebench source (constants/__init__.py:80, run_evaluation.py:215/218); dataset loader; NLI server/client protocol incl. the server-side /sdlg_rank routing; the [:500] context cap that keeps NLI clustering pairs inside DeBERTa's 512-token window; litellm content-None guards and instrument-call temperatures; a third spot-check of pass@k/rarefaction/sign-flip/bootstrap and the N=5 achievable-entropy grid. 132 tests pass (130 -> 132), py_compile clean, campaign dry-run plan correct, work committed (8c7269a). Because this iteration found and fixed two major mechanism-fidelity issues, gold_standard_met is FALSE per the charter; one more fresh pass should sweep the few remaining corners (relevance.py internals, figures on partial artifacts, doc chain) before the loop goes quiet.

R1_faithfulness.evidence: src/diversity/sdlg.py (importance bridge now actually reachable in the live config — T1 fix; tests/test_sdlg_importance.py::test_importance_scores_hit_the_configured_port); clustering/entropy/agent-loop pointers unchanged from iter 11
R1_faithfulness.notes: T1 restored the implemented method to the documented method: I_ij is computable in the checked-in configuration, not just on the lucky default port.

R2_arms_matched.evidence: scripts/run_campaign.py::build_steps (explicit --temperature / --entropy-threshold 0, dry-run re-verified); sdlg.py fallback removal closes the hardcoded-0.7 hole in sweep cells (tests/test_sdlg_importance.py::test_generate_without_alternatives_stays_pure_sdlg)
R2_arms_matched.notes: The last unpinned temperature in any arm (the SDLG fallback's hardcoded 0.7) is gone.

R3_ablations.evidence: GOLD_STANDARD.md R3.1 fallback-layer clause + sdlg.py no-fork failure semantics; RESULTS.md SS2.1 'Arm purity at the fallback layer'; tau_sweep machinery unchanged
R3_ablations.notes: The generator ablation is now pure by construction: every sdlg_fork is SDLG-produced; no-candidate instances fail into the arm's null action exactly as the strategy arm does.

R4_metrics_independent.evidence: Estimator stack untouched this iteration; third spot-check clean (pass_at_k product form, rarefaction identity, empty-patch handling) — scrutiny_12.md 'Seams audited CLEAN'
R4_metrics_independent.notes: No changes to metric code; eval-outcome integrity (iter 11) unchanged.

R5_uncertainty_analysis.evidence: compute_metrics strata/off-mode unchanged; R5.4's SDLG-vs-strategy reading is now attributable (T2 fix) — a 'confidence-independent mechanism' claim cannot be backed by hidden temperature samples
R5_uncertainty_analysis.notes: Mechanism fidelity was the missing precondition for the R5.4 per-generator decomposition.

R6_statistical_rigor.evidence: Confirmatory cell (strategy arm) untouched by both fixes; T2's direction is conservative for the treatment (failure instances become k=1 ties at matched k*) — scrutiny_12.md M2
R6_statistical_rigor.notes: Exact sign-flip + power floor + confirmatory_family artifact gate unchanged (re-derived iters 9-10, spot-checked again).

R7_reproducibility.evidence: Campaign dry-run prints the full pinned plan (re-verified post-fix); RESULTS.md SS2.1 disclosure keeps prose and runtime behavior in sync; harness marker constants verified against the installed swebench version
R7_reproducibility.notes: The SS2.4 deviation-1 documentation is now true of the artifact in the live configuration.

R8_internal_correctness.evidence: 132 pytest pass (+2: live-config URL regression, no-fallback purity with litellm.completion monkeypatched to raise); py_compile clean; legacy VLLMClient/react_agent confirmed outside the campaign path
R8_internal_correctness.notes: The rstrip character-set/suffix confusion class was searched for repo-wide: the only other occurrences are benign (whitespace rstrip, trailing-slash strip).

R9_model_diversity.evidence: model.model_name / api_base config-driven end-to-end unchanged; the T1 fix makes the api_base honoring genuinely port-agnostic (any /v1 endpoint now derives its server root correctly)
R9_model_diversity.notes: A swapped model served on any port now reaches the importance scorer.

R10_writeup.evidence: RESULTS.md SS2.1 arm-purity paragraph; scrutiny_12.md steelman table + limitation disclosures (echo-scoring is run-time-verified only; marker constants version-coupled)
R10_writeup.notes: Docs, spec, code, and tests state the same fallback contract.

issues_found.title: SDLG importance scoring targeted a dead port in the live configuration: api_base.rstrip('/v1') strips a character set and ate the trailing '1' of port 8001 (the checked-in api_base), so every I_ij silently evaluated to 0.0 and the documented vocabulary-bridge method would not actually have run
issues_found.rationale: Verified by direct evaluation ('http://localhost:8001/v1'.rstrip('/v1') == 'http://localhost:800'); all exceptions on that path are swallowed (logger.debug / return None -> 0.0), so no artifact would have recorded the degradation. Fixed with suffix-safe derivation; regression test asserts every importance-query URL starts with http://localhost:8001/v1/ under the live config.

issues_found.title: The SDLG arm silently substituted temperature sampling (hardcoded T=0.7) when SDLG produced no alternatives — the orchestrator logs every fork as sdlg_fork, so the generator ablation and R5.4 would mis-attribute those branches, and T=0.2/1.0 sweep cells lost the temperature match
issues_found.rationale: Removed the fallback: no alternatives -> no fork, the arm's null action, mirroring the strategy arm's collapse-to-dominant-representative failure semantics; conservative at matched k* (failure instances become ties). Rejected alternatives (flagged fallback; temperature-threaded fallback) argued in spec_amendments/applied_12_arm_purity_no_silent_fallback.md. R3.1 amended to name the invariant.

issues_found.title: Stale inline comment claimed 'let the temperature fallback fire' for the reasoning-only path
issues_found.rationale: Comment updated alongside the behavior change so code and comments cannot disagree about the failure semantics.

changes_made.what: Suffix-safe base_url derivation in _get_importance_scores (rstrip('/') then remove a literal '/v1' suffix once); _fallback_temperature removed — generate() returns [greedy] with a logged no-fork warning when no alternatives exist; stale comment updated.
changes_made.why: T1: the live-config port 8001 was being truncated to 800, silently zeroing every importance score. T2: a silent mechanism swap inside an attribution-ablation arm is a confound generator, and its hardcoded 0.7 broke R2.4 in sweep cells.

changes_made.what: +2 tests: every importance-query URL preserves the configured port 8001; the no-alternatives path returns exactly [greedy] with litellm.completion monkeypatched to raise (the sampler can never fire).
changes_made.why: R8.5 — both fixes provable without vLLM/NLI servers; the URL bug survived precisely because the mocks never observed the URL.

changes_made.what: R3.1 amended: arm attributability extends to the fallback layer — an arm that cannot produce candidates must produce NO branch, never silently substitute a different generator.
changes_made.why: Ratchet v2 value-level amendment; rationale + rejected alternatives + tripwire check in review_loop/spec_amendments/applied_12_arm_purity_no_silent_fallback.md (adds an obligation discharged same-iteration; flips nothing).

changes_made.what: SS2.1 'Arm purity at the fallback layer' paragraph: the removed fallback, what it broke, and the no-fork semantics with realized-N flagging.
changes_made.why: R10 — the writeup must disclose the failure semantics the artifacts now enforce.

changes_made.what: Full scrutiny record: big-picture claim, the discharged iteration-11 worklist (markers verified against installed swebench, dataset loader, NLI protocol, truncation seam, litellm guards, estimator third spot-check), T1/T2 findings with evidence, steelman table, limitations, verdict logic.
Amendment record: the two corruptions, why no-branch beats flagged-fallback and temperature-threaded-fallback, tripwire check.
